title: Impact of Close-Election Incumbency on Reelection Probability

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

We will use a Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) to estimate the causal effect of winning a close election on the probability of an incumbent being reelected. The key assumption for RDD is that there is a sharp cutoff in the running variable (vote-share margin) around which the treatment (winning the close election) changes, and that there are no other systematic differences between units on either side of the cutoff.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(rdrobust)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s88_data.csv")

# Define the cutoff point
cutoff <- 0.5

# Create a binary variable for treatment based on the cutoff
data$treatment_binary <- ifelse(data$running_var >= cutoff, 1, 0)

# Run the RDD analysis
# We will use the rdrobust package to estimate the local linear regression
# around the cutoff point
rdd_result <- rdrobust(data$y, data$running_var, data$treatment_binary, c=cutoff, h=0.05)

# Print the estimated causal effect
print(rdd_result$beta)

# Basic robustness check: change the bandwidth
rdd_result_2 <- rdrobust(data$y, data$running_var, data$treatment_binary, c=cutoff, h=0.1)
print(rdd_result_2$beta)
```

## 3. Expected Findings

We expect the coefficient estimate from the RDD analysis to be positive, indicating that incumbents who barely win a close election have a higher probability of being reelected compared to those who barely lose. The magnitude of the effect will depend on the data, but we expect it to be relatively small, as the difference in vote-share margins is likely to be small. The reason for expecting a positive effect is that winning a close election may provide incumbents with more resources, name recognition, and political capital, which can help them in subsequent elections.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: We analyze the discontinuity at the vote-share cutoff to isolate the effect of incumbency.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Winning a close election reduces the probability of reelection.
